account.title: Account & Sync
account.notConfiguredHint: This version does not sync between devices. Everything is saved on this device.
account.privacy: Your study data (review cards, progress, achievements and settings) is saved on this device only. If you sign in, it is also copied to your own private row on the sync server, protected so only you can read it. No analytics, no ads, no third parties. You can delete the server copy at any time.
account.syncFailed: Sync failed. Your changes are kept and will be sent later.
account.offline: Offline — your changes are kept and sent later.
account.deleteData: Delete my data from the server
account.deleteConfirm: Delete your synced copy from the server? The copy on this device stays.
account.deleteFailed: Could not delete the server data.
